returns.title: Refund Policy
returns.intro: Understand our return, refund and exchange process.
returns.body:
How returns, refunds and cancellations work at {store}. Please read this page together with our [Terms & Condition](/policies/terms/).

## If we got it wrong ::damaged-or-defective

Because our products may include glass/mirror components, customers should inspect the package immediately upon delivery.

If a product arrives damaged, please:

- Take photographs/videos of the outer packaging **before opening**
- Record the unboxing process wherever possible
- Take clear photographs of the damaged product and packaging
- Contact us at **{email}** within **48 hours** of delivery.

We will review the evidence and determine the appropriate resolution, which may include replacement, repair or refund, subject to the circumstances.

Please also follow our [pre-installation inspection steps](/policies/shipping/#inspection) before mounting or using your piece.

## If you changed your mind ::change-of-mind

> ! Being finalised
> Our policy on change-of-mind returns and exchanges, including the return window, condition requirements and return shipping, will be published here soon. Until then, please contact us at {email} before placing your order if you have any questions.

## Not eligible ::not-eligible

For customised, personalised, made-to-order or specially manufactured products, return eligibility may differ and will be clearly communicated before purchase.

> ! Being finalised
> The full list of items that cannot be returned will be published here soon. Until then, please contact us at {email} before placing your order if you have any questions.

## Refunds ::refunds

If an order is cancelled after payment has been received, the eligible amount will be refunded through the original payment method or another appropriate method.

> ! Being finalised
> Refund timelines and processing details will be published here soon. Until then, please contact us at {email} before placing your order if you have any questions.

## Cancellations ::cancellations

Customers may request cancellation before the order is dispatched by contacting us at **{email}** .

Once manufacturing, processing or dispatch has begun, cancellation may not be possible depending on the product.

For made-to-order/custom products, cancellation terms will be communicated before purchase.

## Your consumer rights ::your-rights

Nothing in this policy is intended to exclude any consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded under applicable law. Indian e-commerce rules provide specific protections where goods are defective, deficient, spurious, materially different from what was advertised/agreed, or delivered late in circumstances covered by the rules.

## Contact ::contact

For any question about a return, refund or cancellation, contact us directly or use our [contact page](/contact/).

- **Email:** {email}
- **WhatsApp:** [{whatsapp}]({whatsappUrl})
- **Address:** {address}

How orders from {store} are processed, shipped and delivered. Please read this page together with our [Terms & Condition](/policies/terms/).

> Estimated delivery times by region will be published here soon. Until then, please contact us at {email} before placing your order if you have any questions.

## Working days ::working-days

> ! Being finalised
> Our working days for processing and dispatch will be published here soon. Until then, please contact us at {email} before placing your order if you have any questions.

## Address accuracy ::address-accuracy

Customers are responsible for providing an accurate shipping address and contact information.

## Inspecting your delivery ::inspection

**Your Niche piece has arrived. Before you install it, please take a moment to inspect it.**

Our products are carefully inspected and securely packed before dispatch. However, as some of our products are fragile and can be damaged during transit or handling, we require customers to complete a pre-installation inspection before mounting or using the product.

### 1. Record Your Unboxing

Please record a continuous video while opening your package. The video should clearly show the outer packaging, the opening of the package, and the product after removal.

### 2. Inspect Before Installation

Carefully inspect the product for:

- Cracks or breakage
- Scratches or chips
- Damage to edges or corners
- Any visible manufacturing defect
- Any other issue that may have occurred during transit

### 3. Do Not Install a Damaged Product

If you notice any damage or defect, **do not install, mount, modify or use the product.** Keep the product and all original packaging exactly as received and contact us immediately.

### 4. Report Within 24 Hours

Any transit damage or visible defect must be reported to Niche within **24 hours of delivery**, along with clear photographs and/or video of the product and packaging.

### 5. Installation Means Acceptance of Condition

Once the product has been installed, mounted, modified, relocated or otherwise handled beyond the initial inspection, Niche may not be able to treat subsequent damage as transit damage.

Damage caused during installation, mounting, relocation, improper handling, accidental impact or use contrary to the provided installation instructions may not be eligible for replacement or refund.

### 6. Keep the Packaging

Please retain the original packaging until you have completed your inspection and confirmed that the product is in perfect condition. In case of a damage claim, the packaging may be required for assessment.

> ! We're here to help.
> If something doesn't look right, **don't install it. Take a few photos, keep the packaging, and contact us.** Our team will review the issue and guide you through the next steps.

See our [Refund Policy](/policies/returns/) for what happens if a piece arrives damaged.

## Questions or help ::contact

For any question about shipping or delivery, contact us directly or use our [contact page](/contact/).

- **Email:** {email}
- **WhatsApp:** [{whatsapp}]({whatsappUrl})
- **Address:** {address}
